retrievalProfile.description: A low-light, high-grain candid shot of a formal event featuring a central performer and a cluster of balloons under warm stage lighting.
triggerTerms: warm stage glow with motion blur
excludeWhen: sharp focus on all subjects is necessary

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, grainy image capturing a performer on a stage at a formal dance. The scene is dominated by deep shadows in the foreground and a warm, amber-orange glow from stage lights. A bunch of pale balloons acts as a secondary focal point next to the performer, while the foreground audience is rendered in silhouette with significant motion blur.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm stage light vs. deep foreground shadows
Static performer vs. blurred audience movement
Soft balloon textures vs. dark silhouettes
Central stage action vs. peripheral motion

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The performer is positioned slightly off-center in the upper mid-ground, scaled to be recognizable but integrated into the environment.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The cluster of illuminated balloons and the bright stage light in the upper left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright light source, moves to the balloons and performer, then follows the motion blur of the crowd toward the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive dark negative space in the bottom half and right side, creating a sense of depth and atmosphere.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and dark brown shadows providing the base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm amber and orange stage lighting.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale pink and cream from the balloons.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the warm highlights; very low value in the shadows with crushed blacks.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single utilitarian typeface to avoid distracting from the atmospheric image.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides a classic, utilitarian look that fits metadata conventions.
Neutral and legible at small scales.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-light photograph of a 1970s prom stage with a singer in a tuxedo, a bunch of balloons, and a crowd in silhouette. Apply heavy grain, motion blur to the crowd, and a strong orange stage light from the left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a small, centered white sans-serif text block inside a black rectangle at the bottom edge of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the foreground crowd blurred and silhouetted?
Is the text small and centered at the bottom?

mustRedesign: Do not use balanced, even lighting
Redesign any recognizable faces to maintain a candid, blurred feel
postGenerationChecks: Check for high contrast between stage and crowd
Ensure the orange glow feels directional
Verify the presence of motion blur in the foreground
Confirm the mood is nostalgic and slightly melancholic
